'''Tie''': {{legend0|#D2B1D9|40–50%}} {{legend0|#808080|No votes}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Tom Carper]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Lisa Blunt Rochester]] | after_party = Democratic Party (United States) }}The '''2024 United States Senate election in Delaware''' was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the [[United States Senate]] to represent the state of [[Delaware]]. [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] congresswoman [[Lisa Blunt Rochester]] won her first term in office, defeating [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] businessman Eric Hansen. She succeeded Democratic incumbent [[Tom Carper]], who declined to seek a fifth term.{{cite web |last1=Newman |first1=Meredith |date=2023-05-22 |title=U.S. Sen. Tom Carper to retire from politics after nearly 50 years in office |url=https://www.delawareonline.com/story/news/politics/2023/05/22/tom-carper-us-senator-delaware-retire-politics/70241463007/ |access-date=2023-05-22 |website=[[Delaware Online]]}} This was the first open race for this seat since [[1970 United States Senate election in Delaware|1970]]. Republicans have not won a Senate race in Delaware since [[1994 United States Senate election in Delaware|1994]]. Blunt Rochester is both the first woman and first African American to represent Delaware in the Senate, as she did previously in the House. With Blunt Rochester's win and [[Angela Alsobrooks]] winning an open seat in [[2024 United States Senate election in Maryland|Maryland]], this is the first time in history that two African American women serve in the Senate at the same time.{{Cite web |last=Treisman |first=Rachel |date=November 6, 2024 |title=Two Black women will serve together in the Senate for the first time |url=https://www.npr.org/2024/11/06/g-s1-32817/black-female-senators-angela-alsobrooks-lisa-blunt-rochester |access-date=November 25, 2024 |website=NPR}} == Democratic primary == ===Candidates=== ====Nominee==== *[[Lisa Blunt Rochester]], U.S. representative from {{ushr|DE|AL}}{{Cite web |last=Mizelle |first=Shawna |date=2023-06-21 |title=Rep.
